name: LaSalle County, IL
findings: LaSalle County has 348 nonprofit organizations. 169 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 132 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, LaSalle County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 1 religious organization here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
